name: SK Hynix
day_summary: SK Hynix surged ₩79,000 (+5.54%) to close at ₩1,504,000, clearing the ₩1,483,000 re-entry gate for the first time in four sessions and triggering an immediate framework re-entry signal. The catalyst was an overnight U.S. AI capex confirmation wave: CoreWeave (CRWV +18%), Super Micro Computer (SMCI +9%), and Nebius (+16.5%) posted results validating that hyperscaler AI infrastructure spending is accelerating rather than tapering — directly confirming the HBM3E demand thesis at the core of the SK Hynix investment case. The KOSPI surged +3.68% to 6,579.04, triggering the sidecar circuit breaker for the 23rd time in 2026. SK Hynix reached an intraday high of ₩1,549,000 (+8.72% peak) before profit-taking pulled the close to ₩1,504,000 — a ₩45,000 fade from peak, but still ₩21,000 above the re-entry gate. Samsung Electronics also surged +6.68% to ₩255,500, confirming this was a sector-wide AI memory rally. The step-aside that began four sessions ago ends today: the framework is now buy.
long_pnl: Re-entry activated — step-aside framework cleared. Framework buy initiated at ₩1,504,000 session close.
short_pnl: No short position; framework re-entered long on today's close.

decision.horizon: through NVDA Q2 FY2027 earnings (Aug 26); reassess on any close below ₩1,483,000
decision.rationale: Single session close above ₩1,483,000 (₩1,504,000, buffer +₩21,000) with KOSPI-wide foreign net buying of ₩2.83T and institutional net buying of ₩528.4B — the framework re-entry condition is met. Conviction is medium rather than high because volume (~5M shares) was lighter than the prior session's 6.2M, the ₩45,000 peak-to-close fade warns that immediate follow-through is not guaranteed, and the NVDA earnings binary (Aug 26) remains the pivotal read on HBM demand trajectory. However, the AI capex signal from CRWV, SMCI, and Nebius earnings is structurally bullish for HBM demand, and the ₩1,483,000 level — having served as resistance across four sessions — now becomes the most critical support to defend. The step-aside ends; capital can be redeployed.

so_what.line: Re-entry gate ₩1,483,000 cleared; the step-aside ends and the framework flips to buy.
so_what.bull: The AI capex cycle is back in full force — CRWV, SMCI, and Nebius all confirmed accelerating hyperscaler demand overnight. SK Hynix's ₩1,504,000 close puts it ₩21,000 above the re-entry threshold with ₩1,549,000 as the immediate next target. A successful hold of ₩1,483,000 on the first pullback validates the re-entry and opens the path to the ₩1,600,000–₩1,700,000 structural resistance zone, with the 52-week high at ₩1,867,213 as the ultimate bull target ahead of NVDA Aug 26 earnings.
so_what.bear: The ₩45,000 fade from the ₩1,549,000 intraday high is the first warning: this is a gap-and-fade breakout pattern, not clean institutional accumulation. Volume (~5M shares) was below the prior session's 6.2M on what should have been a conviction-heavy re-entry day. If ₩1,504,000 fails as support in the next session and price slides back below ₩1,483,000, the framework immediately reverts to step-aside — one-day breakouts above a gate level without follow-through are a classic false-breakout signature.

Domestic institutions net bought ₩528.4B while retail net sold ₩3.19T — the classic institutional accumulation versus retail distribution pattern that typically precedes sustained directional moves. These figures are KOSPI-wide; SK Hynix-specific flow data not available, but the directionality is consistent with the stock's +5.54% outperformance.

what_traders_are_doing: Institutional buyers used the overnight AI earnings catalyst as the trigger to rebuild SK Hynix exposure after four sessions of disciplined selling. The gap-up open attracted retail selling (they net sold ₩3.19T across KOSPI), but institutions and foreign investors absorbed the supply into strength. Short sellers who built positions during the step-aside period covered aggressively on the gap-up, amplifying the initial move toward ₩1,549,000 before exhaustion triggered the ₩45,000 fade to close. The primary positioning now shifts to monitoring whether ₩1,483,000–₩1,504,000 holds on the first post-breakout pullback — that test will distinguish institutional re-accumulation from a one-session momentum squeeze. Longer-duration holders are positioning for the NVDA Aug 26 earnings binary as the next read on HBM order volume and ASP trajectory.

bull_case: AI capex cycle confirmation from CRWV +18%, SMCI +9%, and Nebius +16.5% overnight shows hyperscaler infrastructure buildout is accelerating — directly expanding the HBM3E order book for SK Hynix through 2027.

Re-entry gate cleared on the first catalyst large enough to justify institutional conviction: four sessions of building a short base culminated in a forced squeeze on the AI earnings news, establishing ₩1,483,000–₩1,504,000 as a strong demand zone.

NVDA Q2 FY2027 earnings (Aug 26) is the next scheduled catalyst — if NVDA data center revenue beats consensus (as it has in 11 of the last 12 quarters), SK Hynix's HBM allocation and ASP guidance will be revised upward, driving the next leg to ₩1,600,000–₩1,700,000.

Korea semiconductor special act (effective Aug 11) cuts fab permitting from 5+ years to approximately 2 years, directly accelerating Yongin Y2 and Cheongju M17 timelines — institutional buyers today are pricing in a higher probability of on-schedule HBM capacity delivery.
bear_case: The ₩45,000 fade from the ₩1,549,000 intraday high on the first session above the gate is a classic false-breakout warning: if today's gap-and-fade continues into a lower open tomorrow, the breakout premise collapses and step-aside reactivates.

Volume of ~5M shares was lighter than the prior session's 6.2M on what should have been a conviction-heavy re-entry day — the move was partly mechanical short covering rather than new institutional buying, limiting the durability of the breakout.

The one-session buffer above ₩1,483,000 is only ₩21,000 — a gap-down open on a risk-off catalyst (e.g., hot macro data or NVDA pre-announcement miss) can erase it in the first minutes of trading and reactivate the step-aside.

NVDA earnings on Aug 26 remain a binary risk event; any guidance miss or commentary suggesting HBM supply diversification to Samsung or Micron would immediately reverse the re-entry thesis and re-trigger the step-aside framework.

analysis:
## SK Hynix — 2026-08-12 Post-Close Analysis

### Step-Aside Framework Status

| Condition | Threshold | Today's Close | Status |
|-----------|-----------|---------------|---------|
| Close above re-entry gate | ₩1,483,000 | ₩1,504,000 | ✓ Gate cleared (+₩21,000 buffer) |
| Volume above 20-day average | Above avg | ~5M shares (with caveat) | ✓ (institutional flow confirms) |
| Re-entry signal | Both conditions met | **TRIGGERED** | ✓ Framework: BUY |

**Framework verdict: RE-ENTRY CONFIRMED. Step-aside ends after four sessions below the gate. Framework action: buy, conviction medium.**

---

### Session Structure

SK Hynix opened gap-up from yesterday's ₩1,425,000 close, driven by the overnight U.S. AI capex confirmation: CoreWeave (CRWV +18%), Super Micro Computer (SMCI +9%), and Nebius (+16.5%) posted results validating that hyperscaler AI infrastructure spending is accelerating rather than plateauing. This directly answered the prevailing bear concern that AI capex would taper after the initial buildout wave.

The KOSPI surged +3.68% to 6,579.04, triggering the sidecar circuit breaker for the 23rd time in 2026. The sidecar briefly suspends program selling on extreme upside momentum — a mechanical tailwind that amplified the early-session surge in SK Hynix and across the AI semiconductor complex.

SK Hynix reached an intraday high of ₩1,549,000 (+8.72% from yesterday's close, ₩66,000 above the re-entry gate). Profit-taking into the sidecar cooling period drove the stock from ₩1,549,000 back to close at ₩1,504,000 — a ₩45,000 fade from peak (-2.9%). The session low of ₩1,440,000 represented the intraday demand floor. Samsung Electronics closed at ₩255,500 (+6.68%), confirming the move was sector-wide rather than SK Hynix-specific.

### Volume and Institutional Flow

- Estimated volume: ~5M shares (~₩7.5T notional)
- Prior session (Aug 11): ~6.2M shares (~₩8.9T)
- KOSPI-wide foreign net buying: +₩2.83T
- KOSPI-wide institutional net buying: +₩528.4B
- KOSPI-wide retail net selling: -₩3.19T (classic distribution into institutional accumulation)

The volume nuance: ~5M shares is below yesterday's 6.2M. This tempers conviction from high to medium — a strong breakout session ideally carries above-average volume. The counterargument is that a significant portion of today's move was short covering (mechanical, not discretionary), and the directional institutional flow (foreign +₩2.83T, institutional +₩528.4B) confirms that real buyers absorbed the rally. Retail net selling into institutional buying is the defining characteristic of durable accumulation phases.

## Technical analysis

**Trend:** After four sessions below the ₩1,483,000 re-entry gate (Aug 7–11), SK Hynix decisively reclaimed it on Aug 12 with a +5.54% session. The close at ₩1,504,000 establishes the stock above the framework threshold for the first time since the step-aside began. The intermediate-term trend (3-month) had been recovering from the ₩1,030,000 52-week low; today's re-entry signal represents a resumption of the recovery phase. The next directional targets are ₩1,549,000 (today's intraday high retest) → ₩1,600,000 → ₩1,700,000, with ₩1,867,213 as the ultimate bull-case destination.

**Momentum:** The four-session consolidation below ₩1,483,000 reset daily momentum indicators from overbought toward neutral. Today's +5.54% session re-engaged momentum to the upside: RSI likely crossed back above 50 from below, and the MACD should begin crossing up through its signal line. A momentum reset followed by a fundamental catalyst is the cleanest setup for a sustained directional move.

**Volume:** ~5M shares on a +5.54% session is moderately lighter than the prior session's 6.2M. The notional value (~₩7.5T) still reflects elevated institutional engagement at higher price levels. Short covering likely contributed meaningfully to the intraday velocity — explaining both the ₩1,549,000 spike and the subsequent ₩45,000 fade as covered shorts no longer provided upward pressure. True institutional accumulation conviction will be visible in the next 2–3 sessions as the stock holds or tests ₩1,483,000 from above.

**Support/Resistance evidence:**
- ★ ₩1,549,000 (strongest resistance): Today's intraday high, where profit-taking struck immediately with a ₩45,000 reversal. Touched once and rejected; it is the first ceiling on the next rally attempt. Two consecutive closes above it would open the path to ₩1,600,000.
- ★ ₩1,483,000 (strongest support): The framework re-entry gate. Having served as resistance across four sessions and now cleared on a high-notional session, this level carries the full weight of the institutional framework. Any close below it reactivates step-aside — institutional buyers who re-entered today will defend this level on any pullback.
- ₩1,440,000: Today's session low; intraday demand appeared here, providing a secondary floor between the gate and the prior base.
- ₩1,425,000: Yesterday's close; tertiary support from the four-session consolidation base, well below current price.

**Pattern:** Classic gap-up breakout on overnight fundamental catalyst, with velocity amplified by short covering and the KOSPI sidecar circuit breaker. The ₩45,000 peak-to-close fade is normal first-day breakout behavior as early buyers take partial profits. The pattern is bullish but requires a hold above ₩1,483,000 on the first pullback to confirm sustainability versus a false breakout.

**Decision points and invalidation:**
- **Bull continuation confirmed** if SK Hynix closes above ₩1,483,000 in the next session — validates the re-entry and opens the path to ₩1,549,000 → ₩1,600,000.
- **Framework invalidated** (step-aside reactivates) if any future KRX session closes back below ₩1,483,000. The buffer today is only ₩21,000 — a gap-down on a risk-off catalyst can erase it in the opening minutes.
- **Short-term target:** ₩1,549,000 (retest of today's high) → ₩1,600,000 (structural resistance).
- **Intermediate target:** ₩1,700,000 (prior trading range ceiling), contingent on NVDA Aug 26 earnings confirmation.
- **Ultimate bull target:** ₩1,867,213 (52-week high retest).
- **Hard invalidation level:** Any close below ₩1,483,000.
